name: Nichinan (Tottori, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Nichinan town emblem in white: a winged device above a ring enclosing a small ring.
history: Municipal flag of Nichinan, a town in Tottori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 October 1959.

features.role: Nichinan town emblem — a winged device above a ring enclosing a small ring
